plugins.name: nld-core-usage
plugins.description: Architectural and how-to skills for using the nld-core library — base model, entity registry, project & execution context, project setup and configuration audit, project catalog (multi-project), the nld docs project UI, connections, structures, field characterisation proposals, structure models (inter-layer lineage), flow lineage tracing (flow-derived upstream/downstream links), structure audits (per-structure data-analysis audits), flows, incremental processing, data quality checks, business dictionary, governance/ownership (structure & flow owners), environment-aware flow scheduling, deployment, execution/incremental info accessors, and the incremental-strategy decision guide.
